proofs.text: Run a fixture holding one passing marked test and one failing one and verify the two entries read `pass` and `fail`; run a fixture whose marked test is skipped and verify no entry for it is written, in `dev/test_multilang_proof_plugins.py`

rule_text: `status` records execution and never availability: `pass` means the test ran and passed, `fail` means it ran and its assertion failed, and a test the run skipped emits no entry at all, so nothing downstream has to tell a broken build from a missing tool
